scripts.build: npm run build:electron && npm run build:windows
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n renderer,electron-main,electron "npm run dev --prefix src/windows/main" "npm run dev --workspace @emw/electron" "npm run dev:electron"
scripts.dev:electron: wait-on tcp:5173 file:src/electron/dist/main.js && cross-env ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electronmon src/electron/dist/main.js
